---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature, schema change, or seed data addition
title: ''
labels: enhancement, PostgreSQL
assignees: ''

---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the pain point?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the expected behavior and functionality this feature will provide.

## Suggested Approach _(optional)_

If known, describe the technical implementation plan. Include affected tables, schema changes, seed data, ETL scripts, verification queries, and any conventions to follow.

## Acceptance Criteria

How will we know this feature is complete and working correctly?

- [ ] Feature behaves as described in the proposed solution
- [ ] Schema changes reflected in `docs/ERD.md`
- [ ] Verification queries in `sql/verify/` cover the change
- [ ] CI passes (schema + seed + verification assertions)
- [ ] No regressions in existing data integrity assertions

## References

Links to related issues, ADRs (`docs/adr/`), documentation, or relevant resources.
